acceptanceCriteria: With the macOS default TMPDIR (/var/folders/..., where /var is a symlink to /private/var) the PSR environment and lifecycle tests in internal/tasks/store pass, or skip with a stated reason, instead of failing UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM.
The production symlink-parent refusal for env files stays in force; only the test fixture path changes (for example by resolving t.TempDir with filepath.EvalSymlinks).
The same tests still pass with a non-symlinked TMPDIR.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, branch from origin/main cd70ba0a (internal/tasks/store unchanged by the branch). `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/store/` with the default TMPDIR under /var/folders fails TestPSREnvironmentSnapshot, TestPSREnvironmentParentAndReadRace (all subtests), TestPSRAllBarrierTerminal, TestPSRConcurrentSweeps and TestPSRDispatchAllocationFence with 'UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM: env file: non-directory or symlink parent' or a downstream 'command boundary not reached'. The same `-run TestPSR` run passes (75.8 s) with TMPDIR set to a non-symlinked directory under /private/tmp. Expected: the fixtures don't depend on whether the host temp root has a symlinked ancestor. Actual: the fixture env-file path inherits /var -> /private/var and trips the production symlink-parent check. Inference: Linux CI passes because /tmp has no symlinked ancestor. Distinct from V1-0723 (long TMPDIR identifier bound).

completion.reason: PSR test fixtures resolve the symlinked TMPDIR (production refusal unchanged) in the rc.2 full-gate test-defect batch; internal/tasks/store passes on hosted macos-15 and locally under /var/folders TMPDIR. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: internal/tasks/store PSR tests fail UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM when TMPDIR has a symlinked ancestor (macOS /var)
